subject: Startups
title: Cash Conversion Cycle
description: Learn Cash Conversion Cycle in one minute.

hook.text: Amazon doesn't just sell fast—it gets paid before it pays suppliers. That cash timing trick funds its entire empire.

buildup.text: Cash conversion cycle measures how many days it takes to turn inventory investment into cash from sales.

discovery.text: Amazon's CCC is negative: customers pay instantly, but Amazon pays suppliers 60–90 days later. It's a cash machine.

twist.text: A negative CCC means the business funds itself from operations. It's like getting an interest-free loan from suppliers.

climax.text: Most startups have positive CCCs—they pay before they collect. Managing that gap is a survival skill.

punchline.text: Get paid before you pay. That's cash flow mastery.

quiz.question: What does a negative cash conversion cycle mean?
options: The company collects cash before paying its suppliers
